outcome.answer: RegSpeech12 is the most direct match: it is a regional corpus of Bengali spontaneous speech across dialects, covering dialect variation in Bangladesh and released as a public dataset for building regional ASR models [1]. BanglaTalk is also relevant because it uses a dialect-aware ASR system for Bengali regional dialects and is designed for real-time speech assistance [3]. For broader Bengali speech processing, other papers focus on long-form ASR and diarization rather than a regional speech corpus specifically [4, 8].
